description: This file defines the Template class within the OpenCart system, which manages template rendering and path configuration using an adaptor pattern.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Manages template rendering via an adaptor pattern, allowing dynamic loading and rendering of templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Template object by loading a specific adaptor class based on a string parameter.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Delegates adding a path to the adaptor object.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Delegates rendering a template to the adaptor object, passing filename and data.
